description: A permissions matrix as a tree in the Svelte 5 data grid: workspaces, resources and actions. Checking a parent checks every descendant, unchecking a descendant flips its ancestors to the indeterminate state, and when every child is checked the parent becomes fully checked again, with a live monthly cost roll-up of what is selected. It is plain user-land: a Set of checked ids and a partial-state map recomputed per render.

faq.question: How is the indeterminate state computed?
faq.answer: For each parent the demo counts checked descendants: none gives unchecked, all gives checked, anything between gives partial, which the cell snippet renders by setting indeterminate on the checkbox.

faq.question: What happens when a parent is toggled?
faq.answer: Its whole subtree is added to or removed from the checked Set, then the partial map is recomputed for every ancestor, so the tree stays consistent in one pass.

faq.question: How is the cost total derived?
faq.answer: A $derived sums monthlyCost over the checked leaf actions, so the total updates as boxes are ticked without any extra event wiring.
